$comment: Additional Context: 'Loadings are unvalidated. You can't test them without users, but you can
score people whose views you know — a few well-documented researchers — and check whether the
axes land where you'd expect. Half an hour, and it catches sign errors and bad loadings before
This file is that check, run by `npm run verify`. It caught two real defects on first run:
1. Seven inverted patch_rebuild signs. The axis runs low='make current systems safe' to
high='design new ones'; the family priors had been written as if it ran the other way,
which placed Agent foundations at +0.10 (near-neutral on architecture) when it is the
2. Debate deriving as internals-POSITIVE. Debate lists 'Superintelligence can fool human
supervisors' among its assumptions — but it lists it as the problem debate ATTACKS, not
as an argument that assurance requires interpretability. Fixed by making a family prior
authoritative on the axis that defines the family.
Expectations are SIGNS, not values. A sign is something we can be confident about from the
agenda's own description; a value is not. Adding a value expectation here would be overfitting
the derivation to our guesses, which is the failure mode this file exists to prevent.

agenda_sign_expectations.why: Substrate-independent theory aimed at architectures stable under self-reflection — the paradigm case of designing new systems rather than patching current ones.
Assumes the model is adversarial and builds protocols around the systems that exist, without needing to understand them internally.
The name is the position: guarantees come from construction.
Interpretability method. If this is not internals-positive the axis is broken.
Scalable oversight using AI to check AI. Never opens the weights, so it is behavioural on the assurance question however 'cognitive' the source labels it.
Measures what deployed systems can do. Behavioural by construction, and about current systems.
Theory family aimed at systems not yet built.

null_expectations.$comment: Axes no Shallow Review field speaks to must stay null on every technical agenda. If any of these acquires a value, something started imputing.

scoring_invariants.why: Spec §18. 'Unsure' is 0.0 and enters the mean; abstain removes the item. An axis whose items are all abstained is excluded, NOT imputed to zero.
Spec §5. Joint takeover risk displays but must be verifiably absent from the scoring path, or the misalignment story is weighted four times.
Spec §7. A target null on an axis drops that axis from its own distance calculation, exactly as a user abstention does.
